newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-KLINSMANN JOINING SAMPDORIA AT END OF SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KLINSMANN JOINING SAMPDORIA AT END OF SEASON.

text.p: Germany captain Juergen Klinsmann will join Italian side Sampdoria from Bayern Munich at the end of the season.

The move was confirmed on Friday by Sampdoria director general Emiliano Salvarezza but he said the club would make no further official comment on the deal until Klinsmann had completed the current season with the German league leaders.
"Klinsmann has a championship to finish. We don't want to create problems for anybody," Salvarezza said.
A spokeswoman for Bayern said Klinsmann would comment only after the club's league match at Hansa Rostock on Friday evening.
Klinsmann said earlier in the season he was giving up a lucrative contract at league leaders Bayern because he was not happy with the way he had been treated at the club.
The move to Sampdoria is likely to be the last major European transfer of the player's career. Klinsmann, who turns 33 in July, is expected to sign a one-year contract.
After next year's World Cup finals, Germany's most prominent player is then expected to retire from international football and finish his career in the United States.
Klinsmann had been linked to several clubs in England but has decided to return to Italy where he used to play for Internazionale Milan.
A newspaper in Klinsmann's home town of Stuttgart, where he first made his name in the game, said the deal had been decided at a meeting at the start of this week.
